roles.title: Software Development Engineer 2
roles.description:
Leading a cross-org effort to automate ticket investigation with AI agents. Live for 3 teams (30+ engineers) with 90% accuracy on holdout tickets, cutting root-cause time from 30-60 min to ~10 min across 1,200+ tickets a year.
Built the agents' context from three layers: operational memory (past tickets clustered into reusable skills), a semantic code graph, and a knowledge layer of wikis, code reviews and design docs.
Rewrote the seller contribution pipeline end to end to support LLM-based validation and enrichment, cutting CI/CD build times by 80%+.
One of the core projects behind World Catalog, which powers Shop Direct: 250M listings for products sold on other sites, shown in Amazon search and Alexa.
Launched 3 microservices with a plugin-based rules engine running 200+ rules for data validation and image enrichment.
